senses.def: A hamlet in Ilton-cum-Pott parish, North Yorkshire, England, previously in Harrogate district (OS grid ref SE1878).
A village and civil parish in Somerset, England, previously in South Somerset district (OS grid ref ST3517).
A civil parish (served by Fearby, Healey and District Parish Council) in North Yorkshire, England, previously in Harrogate district, which includes the hamlet of Ilton.
A hexagonal-trapezohedral mineral containing bromine, chlorine, mercury, silver, and sulfur.
